rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Munafiqun
rhyme_breakers.translation: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allah forgive them. Indeed, Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Munafiqun
rhyme_breakers.translation: And spend [in the way of Allah] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous."

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: The Most Merciful

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: Created man,

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rahman
rhyme_breakers.translation: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Fil
rhyme_breakers.translation: And He made them like eaten straw.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: Alif, Lam, Meem.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: The Byzantines have been defeated

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: In the victory of Allah. He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest attribute in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allah has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allah

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allah].

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support of the believers.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allah - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ar-Rum
rhyme_breakers.translation: Allah is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.

rhyme_breakers.name: At-Talaq
rhyme_breakers.translation: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allah. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out

rhyme_breakers.name: At-Talaq
rhyme_breakers.translation: [He sent] a Messenger [Muhammad] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allah that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allah will have perfected for him a provision.

rhyme_breakers.name: At-Talaq
rhyme_breakers.translation: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Muzzammil
rhyme_breakers.translation: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Muzzammil
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Muzzammil
rhyme_breakers.translation: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Muzzammil
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Muzzammil
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

rhyme_breakers.name: As-Sajdah
rhyme_breakers.translation: Alif, Lam, Meem.

rhyme_breakers.name: As-Sajdah
rhyme_breakers.translation: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.

rhyme_breakers.name: As-Sajdah
rhyme_breakers.translation: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

rhyme_breakers.name: As-Sajdah
rhyme_breakers.translation: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.

rhyme_breakers.name: As-Sajdah
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.

rhyme_breakers.name: As-Sajdah
rhyme_breakers.translation: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.

rhyme_breakers.name: As-Sajdah
rhyme_breakers.translation: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And we made the Torah guidance for the Children of Israel.

rhyme_breakers.name: As-Sajdah
rhyme_breakers.translation: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then We produced after them a generation of others.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then We produced after them other generations.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: So leave them in their confusion for a time.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Mu'minun
rhyme_breakers.translation: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place.

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allah knows your deeds.

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allah] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allah is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allah, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your unwillingness.

rhyme_breakers.name: Muhammad
rhyme_breakers.translation: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allah - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Jinn
rhyme_breakers.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Jinn
rhyme_breakers.translation: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Jinn
rhyme_breakers.translation: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Jinn
rhyme_breakers.translation: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Jinn
rhyme_breakers.translation: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Jinn
rhyme_breakers.translation: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Jinn
rhyme_breakers.translation: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Jinn
rhyme_breakers.translation: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Jinn
rhyme_breakers.translation: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: You have done an atrocious thing.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.

rhyme_breakers.name: Maryam
rhyme_breakers.translation: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Humazah
rhyme_breakers.translation: Woe to every scorner and mocker

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Humazah
rhyme_breakers.translation: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Humazah
rhyme_breakers.translation: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Assuredly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" They say, "Legends of the former peoples,"

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers" -

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And it will be said to those who feared Allah, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allah reward the righteous -

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And those who associate others with Allah say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification?

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allah and avoid Taghut." And among them were those whom Allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure?

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: By Allah, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is the disbelievers' ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And Allah created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Competent.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And Allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And to Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allah, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "The Pure Spirit has brought it down from your Lord in truth to make firm those who believe and as guidance and good tidings to the Muslims."

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches the Prophet." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this Qur'an is [in] a clear Arabic language.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of Allah - Allah will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief... except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. But those who [willingly] open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from Allah, and for them is a great punishment;

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: That is because they preferred the worldly life over the Hereafter and that Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to renounce their religion] and thereafter fought [for the cause of Allah] and were patient - indeed, your Lord, after that, is Forgiving and Merciful

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: [It is but] a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who have done wrong out of ignorance and then repent after that and correct themselves - indeed, your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, Abraham was a [comprehensive] leader, devoutly obedient to Allah, inclining toward truth, and he was not of those who associate others with Allah.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: [He was] grateful for His favors. Allah chose him and guided him to a straight path.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then We revealed to you, [O Muhammad], to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of those who associate with Allah.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in a way that is best. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has strayed from His way, and He is most knowing of who is [rightly] guided.

rhyme_breakers.name: An-Nahl
rhyme_breakers.translation: And if you punish [an enemy, O believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: Ya, Seen.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: By the wise Qur'an.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: On a straight path.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

rhyme_breakers.name: Ya-Sin
rhyme_breakers.translation: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Insan
rhyme_breakers.translation: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Insan
rhyme_breakers.translation: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Insan
rhyme_breakers.translation: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Insan
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Insan
rhyme_breakers.translation: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Insan
rhyme_breakers.translation: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Insan
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Insan
rhyme_breakers.translation: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Insan
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Insan
rhyme_breakers.translation: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.

rhyme_breakers.name: Al-Insan
rhyme_breakers.translation: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

rhyme_breakers.name: At-Tin
rhyme_breakers.translation: By the fig and the olive

rhyme_breakers.name: At-Tin
rhyme_breakers.translation: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;

rhyme_breakers.name: At-Tin
rhyme_breakers.translation: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.

rhyme_breakers.name: Az-Zalzalah
rhyme_breakers.translation: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.

rhyme_breakers.name: Az-Zalzalah
rhyme_breakers.translation: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,

rhyme_breakers.name: Az-Zalzalah
rhyme_breakers.translation: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

rhyme_breakers.name: Nuh
rhyme_breakers.translation: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

rhyme_breakers.name: Nuh
rhyme_breakers.translation: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,

rhyme_breakers.name: Nuh
rhyme_breakers.translation: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.

rhyme_breakers.name: Nuh
rhyme_breakers.translation: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "

rhyme_breakers.name: Nuh
rhyme_breakers.translation: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers

rhyme_breakers.name: Nuh
rhyme_breakers.translation: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

rhyme_breakers.name: Nuh
rhyme_breakers.translation: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

rhyme_breakers.name: Nuh
rhyme_breakers.translation: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

rhyme_breakers.name: Nuh
rhyme_breakers.translation: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse

rhyme_breakers.name: Nuh
rhyme_breakers.translation: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "

rhyme_breakers.name: Nuh
rhyme_breakers.translation: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
